# Feats #350 fixtures

Exact pinned snapshots for the 100 ordered candidates in GitHub issue #350.
`pf1-content/` contains those candidate YAML files and the pinned manifest;
`pf1/` contains the pinned system manifest and tracked empty pack directories.
`supporting-sources/` contains complete, byte-exact supporting rule snapshots.
`comparison-sources/` contains PCGen evidence at
`25523dbcf10e86c280fc0f447167ea43d67419d3`.

`provenance.json` pins the ordered selection and source hashes; `preview.json`
retains complete-source prerequisite identities, without pretending the reduced
lookup fixture includes unrelated entries. The fixture importer independently
reproduces all selected descriptions, detail, Sources, Modifiers and Notes.
`original-identities.json` freezes every original shared value, fixture and legal
inventory file; `protected-context.json` protects the complete historical context
union, including held dependencies. `verification.json` records complete CLI,
wrapper, transport, resource and historical reconstruction proofs.

`release.json` is an isolated one-definition Catalog Release. Only Skill Focus
(Knowledge [Engineering]) is admitted. The 99 other candidates remain held.
`data.ts` validates fixture boundaries; `sheet.ts` adapts published reviewed
bodies for isolated public resolver and saved-sheet tests. Unsupported automatic
rank calculation remains visible; rank Situations are manually selected.

See [the batch report](../../../docs/catalog-import/feats-350.md) for evidence,
counts, gaps, actual checks and review limitations. These fixtures use portable
TMPDIR/mkdtemp storage and require no external checkout or environment file.
